summary: GP-Act III Acquisition Corp. (a SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting Non-Redemption Agreements with shareholders who agreed not to redeem 8,074,387 Class A shares and to vote for extension and trust amendment proposals at an extraordinary general meeting. The extension moves the business combination deadline from May 13, 2026 to November 13, 2026. No price per share, premium, or advisor named. This is a classic SPAC extension restructuring to avoid liquidation. Watch shareholder vote outcome and any subsequent de-SPAC announcement; risk includes failure to secure approval or find a target.
